question: Choose the antonym of 'eminent":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"eminent"** means someone or something that is famous, respected, or outstanding in a particular field. (प्रतिष्ठित, प्रसिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example:** The eminent scientist received a prestigious award for her groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **"Obscure"** refers to something that is not well-known, unclear, or difficult to understand. It is the opposite of eminent. (अस्पष्ट, अज्ञात)
 
 
• **Example:** The poet remained obscure during his lifetime but gained recognition after his death.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"eminent"** is **"obscure"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prominent** (प्रसिद्ध, प्रमुख): Something or someone that is important or easily noticeable.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a prominent figure in the world of politics.
 
 
 
• **Celebrated** (प्रसिद्ध, सम्मानित): Widely admired and praised.
 
 
• **Example:** The celebrated author was invited to speak at the literary festival.
 
 
 
• **Distinguished** (विशिष्ट, प्रतिष्ठित): Marked by excellence, known for achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** The distinguished professor has published numerous research papers.

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
